# Monemee SDK

> Sell an app through Monemee: hosted checkout, unlocking buyers inside the app after payment, and license key validation with offline support. For web apps with login and for downloadable software (Electron, Tauri, browser extensions, CLIs, Python). MIT licensed.

- Setup: `npx monemee init` (browser login, product, .env, code integration, test mode)
- Web app server: `monemee-node` - `createMonemee({ getRef })`, `app.use(monemee.routes())`, `monemee.requireAccess()`, `monemee.nextRoute()`, `monemee.guard(request)`
- Web app frontend: `monemee-react` - `MonemeeProvider`, `AccessGate`, `BuyButton`, `LicenseForm`, `useAccess`
- Downloadable software: `monemee-client` (JavaScript) and `monemee` (Python) - `activate`, `check`, offline via Ed25519-signed responses
- Releases: GitHub Action `monemee/monemee-sdk/action@v1`
- HTTP API: `POST /api/v1/apps/{access,claim,test-claim}` (app secret), `POST /api/v1/licenses/{validate,activate,deactivate}` (public)
- Buy link: `https://monemee.com/buy/<product_id>?ref=<user_id>`
- Pricing: SDK free; Monemee charges a per-sale fee from 29% down to 9% depending on revenue, no monthly fee
